name: Monthly New Assets Depreciation List
query:
select je.parent 'Journal Entry', je.credit Amount,je.reference_name Asset,a.asset_name 'Asset Name',a.purchase_date 'Purchase Date', 
    a.posting_date 'Posting Date', a.asset_category 'Asset Category', 
    (select income_depreciation_amount from `tabDepreciation Schedule` where parent=a.name and schedule_date=%(to_date)s) 'Dep Amount'
from `tabJournal Entry Account` je, tabAsset a 
where a.name=je.reference_name and a.name in ( 
    select name 
    from tabAsset 
    where is_existing_asset=0 and available_for_use_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s and docstatus=1
) 
and je.account='120060004 - Stock Asset - BDBL' group by a.name order by a.posting_date desc;
